items.question: A registration hold showed up in OSCAR. What does it stop me from doing, and who has to remove it?
items.gold_answer: A registration hold prevents adding or removing courses, dropping courses, and withdrawing. The department that placed the hold must remove it.

items.question: Who should I ask for a prerequisite permit if OSCAR blocks me from a class?
items.gold_answer: The student should contact the department teaching the course and request a prerequisite permit.

items.question: Can I switch a Georgia Tech class into or out of audit mode after Phase II registration ends?
items.gold_answer: Updates to or from audit grade mode may be made only during an active registration period, Phase I or Phase II.

items.question: How many pass/fail credits can count toward a Georgia Tech undergraduate degree?
items.gold_answer: No more than nine pass/fail credit hours may count toward an undergraduate degree, in the Free Electives area.

items.question: Is my Georgia Tech financial-aid offer based on taking 12 credits, and what can happen if I enroll in fewer?
items.gold_answer: Financial aid offers assume full-time enrollment of at least 12 billable credit hours. Enrolling less than full-time can reduce or eliminate eligibility for some funds.

items.question: I'm a single grad student with no partner or children. Am I eligible to apply for Georgia Tech family housing?
items.gold_answer: No. Single students are not eligible for family housing; the family application is for students living with a spouse, domestic partner, or children.

items.question: If my F-1 visa is revoked and I leave the U.S., can I use that visa to come back?
items.gold_answer: No. A revoked visa cannot be used to re-enter the United States; after leaving, the student must apply for a new visa before attempting to re-enter.

items.question: Does registering a graduate internship at Georgia Tech charge tuition, and does it keep me full-time?
items.gold_answer: The Graduate Internship Program has no tuition or required program fees, and registration in an audit-credit Graduate Internship course provides full-time enrollment status.
